onset.Description: Seconds from the first sample of this Percept LFP run, mapped from the authors' aligned time axis (see _note)

duration.Description: Segment rows: end - start from the authors' datafile (n/a if end < start); gait rows: 0

trial_type.Description: Segment label as written in the authors' datafile, or gait event

Levels.Selected stop: authors' label variant (not selected by the authors' scripts, which match 'Selected_stop')
Levels.Selected_stop_start: authors' label variant (not selected by the authors' scripts)
Levels.Freezing_walk_initiation: authors' freezing segment at gait initiation

foot.Description: Gait rows: right (GaitEvents.rf_events) or left (lf_events); n/a for segments

sample.Description: round(onset x 250), 0-based sample of this run

source.Description: datafile: subjectdata.events_filt in sub-XX-datafile.m of github.com/PKlocke/SenseFOG-Documentation (b87df3f), copied to code/fix-20261030_authors_timepoints.tsv; gaitfilt_cor: sourcedata .../motion/*_gaitfilt_cor.mat

datafile_index.Description: Segment rows: index i of events_filt.<task>(i) in the authors' datafile

_note: fix-20261030 (code/fix-20261030_gait_events.py). Authors' artefact samples for this run (datafile task Walk): E = 13170 (EEG, 1 kHz, counted from the first 'M  1' marker), L = 9815 (LFP resampled to 1 kHz); E > L: the authors cut EEG and IMU by 3355 samples and subtract 3355 ms from the datafile segments, so onset = segment time - 3356 ms and gait time - 1 ms.
